goal: Add reference-board PNG export, material image inspection, global command search, and material favorites/recent use.

throughputCheckpoint.blockingFirstSteps: Trace basket, catalog, tool command and modal contracts before assigning disjoint file ownership.
throughputCheckpoint.independentWorkstreams: The feature owner implements PNG export, one worker implements viewer/preferences and one implements global command search. Root owns independent browser checks and final verification.
throughputCheckpoint.sharedMutableState: App and header integration have one writer. Viewer/preferences and basket export have separate writers with agreed store APIs.
throughputCheckpoint.smallestSafeDecomposition: Three implementation owners with one integration lead, plus root verification; no competing edits to shared UI files.

fullSuite.failureReason: New desktop grid geometry assertions used a <0.5px tolerance against integer clientWidth. Actual discrepancy was0.5px after2x scaling; changed to <=2CSSpixels for layout rounding. No production change was needed.

coverage: Viewer grid bounds, transforms and keyboard focus
Favorites persistence and malformed storage recovery
Palette keyboard/material/workspace navigation and mobile entry
Night/NewYear PNG exact accent pixels and Traditional Chinese labels

reviewFindingsResolved: Composition grid now follows actual image bounds/transforms
Pan is bounded to the actual scaled image

implementation.board: 2400px PNG of every selected built-in material in basket order, with role/title/pose/license/source; localized labels and active theme; all images or error with cancellation/retry.
implementation.viewer: 1x–3x zoom, bounded pointer pan, mirror, image-aligned thirds/center guides, grayscale, reset, keyboard shortcuts and nested native dialog focus restoration.
implementation.palette: Lazy global Ctrl/Cmd+K search of routes, materials, current workspace commands, settings, basket, theme and language; unsaved work guards and mobile menu entry.
implementation.preferences: Known IDs only; separate favorites and latest-first recent use capped at12; localStorage recovery and session fallback.

limitations: Boards contain built-in basket references; uploaded photos remain outside the basket/export.
Viewer transforms only affect inspection and do not modify generation inputs.
Recent use records opening details/preview or successfully selecting/using references; filtering/favoriting is excluded.
